text:
dan_arch: quick follow-up to the CP-split RFC. proposing a 'locality boundary' that owns ephemeral egress leases, src-ip affinity, and a tiny cert bundle per-region. CP stays canonical for metadata/state.

alex_m: curious — how's this different from relay vs peering we've debated?

dan_arch: ascii sketch:
```
global-cp
  |
  +-- region-A-boundary --> tenant-egress-pool-A (ENI/NAT) --> internet or private endpoint
  +-- region-B-boundary --> tenant-egress-pool-B
```
boundaries are thin: manage L3/L4 egress, allocate leases, and short-circuit. relays remain for control flows.

priya_r: they sound like lightweight operators. do they terminate traffic?

dan_arch: no inference stacks. they NAT/affine and enforce local policy.

jamal_s: security risk: cert/key material at boundary increases blast radius. rotation plan?

dan_arch: boundary keys are short-lived and KMS-wrapped. CP issues signed lease tokens with TTL (default 10m). renewals required; if CP partitioned, boundary serves existing leases until expiry then marks degraded. include nonce anti-replay.

sara_ops: private-only customers?

dan_arch: same surface; egress-pool maps to private peering/privatelink instead of NAT.

alex_m: failure semantics? fail-open vs closed?

dan_arch: fail-soft: continue until lease TTL expires; stop issuing new leases while disconnected, surface region degraded.

priya_r: any perf/cost estimates?

dan_arch: prelim sim: with ~30% regional-local traffic, p95 improved ~20-25%, egress cost ~10-15% lower for many customers. needs load testing.

jamal_s: ops: more units to monitor/rotate. central logging?

dan_arch: boundaries export lease and health metrics to CP pipeline; automated remediation playbook.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist v0.1: [boundary image], [lease protocol v2], [metrics export], [private-endpoint mapping], [cutover playbook].

sara_ops: rollout: feature-flag per-customer; start with dev tenants in region-A for 2w, monitor p95, egress bill, NAT exhaustion.

alex_m: Dedicated/private compatibility?

dan_arch: Dedicated: boundary as sidecar inside customer VPC. Private/airgapped: boundary with async CP sync. API consistent.

priya_r: add to security checklist: least-priv IAM, KMS envelope separation, mTLS CP<->boundary, signed lease tokens with nonce, rotation cadence.

jamal_s: add integration test for route-flap during lease renewal to avoid src-ip flip mid-connection.

dan_arch: will add RFC appendix with lease token format, TTL defaults, health signals, cutover playbook, rollout gates. action items:
- dan_arch: update appendix + diagram (due EOD Fri)
- priya_r: security checklist (due Mon)
- jamal_s: NAT/route-flap test plan (due Wed)
- sara_ops: rollout playbook draft (due next Fri)

alex_m: :thumbsup: naming nit: call it "locality boundary" in docs.

dan_arch: ACK. will push draft to RFC repo and ping arch review. thanks.
